verdict.rationale: Unleash documents API keys for 'other tools and automation', and backend tokens can be scoped to specific projects and a single environment. It also documents RBAC with custom root and project roles, so least-privilege scoping of credentials is a first-party capability. However, the evidence never ties these scoped tokens to Admin API or MCP agent use: an agent managing flags needs write access, and scoping write credentials is not shown. Missing for 10: documented least-privilege scoping for Admin API or personal access tokens used by agents, guidance on credentials for the MCP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
